title.zh: 将宿务省阿尔高市镇阿尔高中级学校的名称变更为Antonio Miñoza中级学校的法案
title.en: An Act Changing the Name of the Argao Intermediate School in the Municipality of Argao, Province of Cebu, to Antonio Miñoza Intermediate School
title.orig: An Act Changing the Name of the Argao Intermediate School in the Municipality of Argao, Province of Cebu, to Antonio Miñoza Intermediate School

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1960/ra_2807_1960.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The name of the Argao Intermediate School in the Municipality of Argao, Province of Cebu, is hereby changed to Antonio Miñoza Intermediate School.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 19, 1960.
